options.label: Scheme
options.help: https verifies the certificate; there is deliberately no option to switch that off

options.label: Path
options.help: Starts with /, for example /health. A query string is allowed: /ping?src=fogping

options.label: Host header
options.help: Ask for a different site on the same address (virtual hosting). Empty = the target's host.

options.label: Expected status
options.help: 0 = any status below 400 counts as up. Otherwise only exactly this status does.

options.label: Follow redirects
options.help: Off: a 301 is the answer. On: follow up to 5 redirects and time the whole chain.
